name: Glaucous Riverwight

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The riverwight makes two attacks, using Slam or Flank Clap in any combination.

Actions.name: Slam
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft. 8 (1d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 6 (1d12) Force damage, and the target has the Prone condition.
answersAlso: It opens a fight by rearing

Actions.name: Pressure Snap (Recharge 5-6)
Actions.text: *Dexterity Saving Throw*: DC 13, each creature in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the riverwight. *Failure:* 31 (9d6) Bludgeoning damage. *Success:* Half damage.

Actions.name: Flank Clap
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft. 8 (1d8 + 4) Thunder damage.
Actions.flavor: The riverwight slaps its waterlogged flanks together with a wet, booming crack.

Bonus Actions.name: Whelm
Bonus Actions.text: The riverwight whelms one Medium or smaller creature it is grappling. While whelmed, the target has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, has Total Cover against attacks and other effects outside the riverwight, and takes 6 (1d12) Force damage at the start of each of the riverwight's turns. The riverwight can have only one creature whelmed at a time. If the riverwight takes 12 damage or more in a single turn from the whelmed creature, the riverwight must release the target at the end of that turn, and the target exits Prone in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the riverwight. If the riverwight dies, a whelmed creature pulls free Prone by using 5 feet of movement.

Traits.name: Sure Footing
Traits.text: Difficult Terrain composed of water, mud, or rubble doesn't cost the riverwight extra movement, and the riverwight can move across water, mud, or rubble without needing to make an ability check.

lore: It is the drowned Underdark given a boneless will — a living sluice of river-water and porcelain that creeps up dead shafts to feast on battlefields and bear the still-twitching down to its larder in the deep.
